title: "Basketball Games Analysis"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

library(tidyverse)

# Read the Games.csv file
games <- read_csv("Games.csv")

# Display the first few rows
head(games)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

# Data summary
glimpse(games)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

# Scatter plot with points colored by frequency
games_counts <- games %>%
  group_by(homeScore, awayScore) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(games_counts, aes(x = homeScore, y = awayScore, color = count)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "darkred", name = "Frequency") +
  labs(
    title = "Home Score vs Away Score (Colored by Frequency)",
    x = "Home Score",
    y = "Away Score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold")
  )
```
